audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phase reasons are shared template text keyed to 'Quickdraw's cooldown', with no numbers and nothing about how his shotgun actually works.
audit.why: New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units, so the minion wave is a wall against his autos — that, plus Quickdraw's 16s and its resistance stacks, is what decides each stage.
audit.corrected: Phase reasons rewritten around minion-blocked bullets, Quickdraw's True Grit and Smoke Screen's 26s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'his ultimate changes the math too'; the item stages gave no reason.
audit.why: Collateral Damage is 100s at rank 1 and hits the first champion in its path, so the wave protects you from it too. Your spike is Lich Bane inside his 16s Quickdraw gap.
audit.corrected: phases[4] now names Collateral Damage and the first-champion rule; phases[5] and phases[6] key the fight to Quickdraw.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: his bullets cannot pass through units, Smoke Screen reduces sight rather than blinding, and dashing towards you gives Quickdraw two stacks of True Grit.
audit.why: Riot's descriptions: New Destiny — 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units'; Smoke Screen — 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range'; Quickdraw — 'If Graves dashes towards an enemy champion, gain two stacks of True Grit instead', and 'Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill'.
audit.corrected: The minion wall is stated in phases[0].why and dosFull[1].d, the sight reduction in dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns, and the True Grit stacking in phases[3].why and report[5].t.

audit.why: Quickdraw 16/15/14/13/12 and it refunds off autos, Smoke Screen 26/24/22/20/18, End of the Line 13s and Collateral Damage 100s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into winCon, phases[1], phases[3], phases[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull and dontsFull descriptions did not match their titles — 'Burn R1 to poke' was described as diving with no shroud and no energy.
audit.corrected: Each description rewritten to its own title, with Akali's real 110 energy Q cost and 120s ultimate.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — shroud his Quickdraw and burst the gap. Akali wins the Quickdraw cooldown windows.
edits.after: Keep minions between you — his bullets cannot pass through them. Akali wins the Quickdraw windows.

edits.before: Shroud his Quickdraw and burst the gap. Track Quickdraw before every commit and keep the wave on your side.
edits.after: Shroud his Quickdraw and burst the gap. It is 16s at rank 1, but autos refund it, so make him miss.

edits.before: Q-poke on energy rhythm wins the chip war. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: New Destiny fires four bullets that cannot pass through units — stand behind a minion and his autos hit it, not you.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it once his Quickdraw is spent on its 16s.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Graves must walk into your range.
edits.after: Full kit online: E-mark him, dash the angle, and Shroud the shotgun return before the reload comes back up.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: dashing toward you hands his Quickdraw two stacks of True Grit, so make him dash away instead.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Both R casts execute, and Collateral Damage (100s) only hits the first champion in its path — keep the wave in that line.

edits.before: Lich Bane is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Quickdraw's cooldown.
edits.after: Lich Bane is your spike — force the fight the moment his Quickdraw has been spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Graves carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on and one rotation kills him, but his resistance stacks grow off autos — do not give him a long duel.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Quickdraw (16s at rank 1): his dash, but hitting you with autos refunds it. - Smoke Screen (26s): cuts your sight, not his. - New Destiny: four bullets that cannot pass through units, so minions are cover.

edits.before: Q Graves at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Q him at 550 from behind a minion, E-mark and dash once Quickdraw is spent, then Shroud the shells.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Chasing him in the open — every auto he lands refunds Quickdraw and stacks his resistances.

edits.before: Q Graves at max blade range, E-dash the angle when his answer is down, and shroud the return fire.
edits.after: Five Point Strike costs 110 energy at rank 1 — poke on the regen, behind a minion he cannot shoot past.

edits.before: Graves wastes Quickdraw — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Smoke blanks his shotgun line and the dash lands on nothing.

edits.before: That is Graves's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His shells plus a Quickdraw reposition beat any naked commit you make here.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts your sight range, not his — do not chase blind.

edits.before: Diving with no shroud and no energy — Akali without resources is a melee mage with paper armor.
edits.after: Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1 — cast one is not poke, it is half of your kill window.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Shroud his answer, Q-burst.
edits.after: His bullets cannot pass through units, so use the minions. Dashing at you gives Quickdraw two True Grit stacks.

notes: Only 64 recorded games at Emerald+, so the 52.45% win rate is thin — I wrote nothing that leans on it. suspectNames flagged 'Drop Twilight Shroud' in wants.you[1]: false positive on the name, but that same line says Shroud makes you 'untargetable'. Per Riot's description she is invisible and cannot be selected, which is not the same thing (ground-placed effects still hit her). That wording appears in several Akali matchups in champ-data/content/akali.js and deserves a global sweep.
